name: Nakayama Steel Works, Ltd.
summary: Nakayama Steel Works, Ltd. engages in the steel, engineering, building materials, and real estate businesses in Japan. It offers steel coil products, including hot, pickled, plated, slit, and striped /pattern coils; and steel plate products, such as thick steel and NP steel plates, leveling sheets, checker plate, and pattern steel sheet, as well as hot rolled steel products. The company also provides bars and wire rod products comprising steel bars, burn-in- coils, and wire rods, as well as lightweight C-shaped steel, pipes, wire rod secondary products, steel billets, and by-products.
